summary_1line: King Janaka explains the origin of Shiva’s great bow and recounts how he discovered the earth-born Sita while ploughing a sacrificial field.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Janaka ploughs the sacrificial field when a radiant infant girl emerges from the furrow of the earth.
Shiva lifts his immense bow in wrath before the frightened gods after Daksha’s sacrifice is destroyed.
Janaka respectfully addresses the sage Vishwamitra and the two princes in his court at dawn.
